Conclusion: The test `tornado.test.web_test.StaticFileTest.test_static_unsatisfiable_range_end_less_than_start` failed because it expected the "Content-Range" header to be set when performing a HEAD request, but it was not. This is due to the fact that the method `get_and_head` in `StaticFileTest` performs a GET and HEAD request and checks if any "Content-*" headers differ between the two requests. However, the issue lies in the way the range header is handled when it is invalid (i.e., start greater than end). In such cases, Tornado sets the "Content-Range" header to None for the HEAD response, whereas it should be set to a valid value.

```
tornado.web.StaticFileHandler.handle_request
```
